zh-CN.title: 小程序补齐历史功能
items: 广场新增官方置顶发言与空间成员、在线成员入口
欢迎消息支持多条文字、图片、视频、语音和文件，并可调整顺序
未认证引导、更多语言偏好与跨设备消息删除同步现已补齐

en.title: Earlier features completed in the mini program
items: Square now includes official pinned posts plus full and online member directories
Welcome messages can contain multiple texts, photos, videos, voice clips, and files in a custom order
Verification guidance, additional language preferences, and cross-device message deletion sync are now included
